scripts.build: find dist -name .DS_Store -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html 404.html styles.css script.js dist/ && if [ -d assets ]; then cp -R assets dist/assets; fi && if [ -d videolar ]; then mkdir -p dist/videolar && find videolar -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name 'Video #1.mp4' ! -name 'Video #4.mp4' ! -name 'Video #6.mp4' ! -name 'Video #7.mp4' ! -name 'Video #9.mp4' -exec cp {} dist/videolar/ \;; fi && if [ -d fotograflar ]; then cp -R fotograflar dist/fotograflar; fi && if [ -d logolar ]; then cp -R logolar dist/logolar; fi && if [ -d baglantilar ]; then cp -R baglantilar dist/baglantilar; fi && find dist -name .DS_Store -delete
